verdict.rationale: Nix and NixOS are inherently self-hosted: users install the Nix package manager or NixOS directly on their own machines or servers via documented installation scripts, and can deploy NixOS on physical hardware, live CDs, or their own EC2 instances, with no SaaS dependency required to run the core product. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation framed around 'self-hosting' as a deployment mode (e.g., enterprise/production self-host guides) and independent corroboration of large-scale self-hosted deployments.
